subject: snowmountain
name: 雪山
label: 三角小雪山
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One large mountain with a simple pointed peak and a single zigzag snow-cap line.
Center the entire subject with generous empty margin. No tiny repetitive details or hatching; palm fronds if present are 5 to 6 large smooth leaf shapes, with at most three trunk seams. Water has at most two single curved strokes. Do not add any other objects.
